recipe.title: Banana cake
recipe.notes: This recipe is from the Edmonds cookbook.

i.n: ripe bananas (3 or 4 depending on size)

method.s: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add mashed banana and stir thoroughly.
Stir baking soda into hot milk and add to creamed mixture.
Sift flour and baking powder. Fold into mixture.
Turn into a greased and lined 20 cm round cake tin (a ring tin works well).
Bake at 180 deg C (not fan bake) for 50 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.
Leave in tin for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack.
Leave to cool, then ice with cream cheese icing.

recipe.title: Lemon cream cheese icing
recipe.notes: This recipe is by Annabel Langbein.

method.s: Blend butter and cream cheese in a bowl or food processor until smooth.
Beat in icing sugar and salt, using extra icing sugar or a little water if necessary to achieve a spreadable yet firm consistency.
